title: "Datasets"

## Dataset index

BEAR stores each data source separately (see `data/`) and also provides a single
`BEAR.rds` dataset for download. For very large datasets, `BEAR.rds` contains
only a smaller selection of rows.

{{< include _dataset_index.md >}}
